stages.name: Foundations
stages.exercise: Run claude in a real repo. Ask it to explain the codebase, fix a small bug, then /rewind the change. Cycle permission modes with Shift+Tab and run /init to draft a CLAUDE.md.

stages.name: Surfaces
stages.exercise: Open the same repo in VS Code or JetBrains and in the desktop app. Start a web session and pull it into your terminal with claude --teleport.

stages.name: Extend
stages.exercise: Write one skill, add a PostToolUse hook that formats edited files, connect one MCP server, and create one subagent. Then install a plugin from a marketplace.

stages.name: Scale and automate
stages.exercise: Run two sessions in separate worktrees and watch them in agent view. Pipe a log into claude -p, try /loop, and run /install-github-app on a test repo.

stages.name: Control and tune
stages.exercise: Write allow and deny rules in .claude/settings.json, enable the sandbox, inspect /context and /usage, and compare effort levels on the same task.

stages.name: Teams and SDK
stages.exercise: Skim managed settings and provider setup, then write a short Agent SDK script that loads your CLAUDE.md and adds one custom tool.

concepts.title: Agentic loop
concepts.summary: Claude gathers context, takes an action, checks the result, and repeats until the task is done.

concepts.title: Built-in tools
concepts.summary: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, search, web fetch, Monitor and more. Each tool has its own permission behavior.

concepts.title: Context window
concepts.summary: System prompt, CLAUDE.md, files, and tool output all share one window. /compact summarizes when it fills.

concepts.title: Permission modes
concepts.summary: Default, acceptEdits, plan, and auto mode, where a classifier approves safe actions. Cycle with Shift+Tab.

concepts.title: CLAUDE.md
concepts.summary: Markdown instructions loaded at session start, from user, project, and nested directory files. Keep them short and specific.

concepts.title: Auto memory
concepts.summary: Claude records its own learnings as it works and recalls them in later sessions.

concepts.title: Checkpoints, /rewind
concepts.summary: Edits are checkpointed as Claude works. /rewind restores code, conversation, or both.

concepts.title: Sessions
concepts.summary: Conversations persist. Name them, --continue, --resume, branch, export, and move them between surfaces.

concepts.title: Slash commands
concepts.summary: Built-in commands such as /context, /usage, /doctor, /compact, and /init, plus bundled skills.

concepts.title: Terminal CLI
concepts.summary: The full-featured terminal app: flags, interactive mode, shell commands with !, and history search.

concepts.title: Terminal setup
concepts.summary: Terminal config, fullscreen rendering, vim mode, status line, keybindings, voice dictation, and screen readers.

concepts.title: VS Code, JetBrains
concepts.summary: Editor integrations with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and selection context.

concepts.title: Desktop app
concepts.summary: Parallel sessions with git isolation, visual diff review, app previews, scheduled tasks, and Dispatch from your phone.

concepts.title: Web sessions
concepts.summary: Cloud sessions from the browser with no local setup. Move work with --cloud and --teleport, and auto-fix PRs.

concepts.title: Remote and mobile
concepts.summary: Continue a local session from your phone or any browser, and start or steer tasks from the mobile app.

concepts.title: Chrome, computer use
concepts.summary: Claude in Chrome tests and debugs web apps. Computer use drives native GUI apps from the CLI.

concepts.title: .claude directory
concepts.summary: The .claude/ and ~/.claude/ folders hold settings, skills, subagents, hooks, commands, rules, and memory.

concepts.title: Skills
concepts.summary: Folders with a SKILL.md and optional scripts. Only the description loads until needed. Invoke with /name or let Claude choose.

concepts.title: Hooks
concepts.summary: Deterministic shell, HTTP, or prompt handlers on events like PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop. They can block actions.

concepts.title: MCP servers
concepts.summary: Model Context Protocol servers add external tools and data such as issue trackers, chat, databases, and design docs.

concepts.title: Plugins
concepts.summary: Shareable bundles of skills, subagents, hooks, and MCP servers, installed from marketplaces and testable with evals.

concepts.title: Subagents
concepts.summary: Specialized agents with their own prompt, tools, and fresh context. They keep the main context clean and can run in the background.

concepts.title: Output styles
concepts.summary: Change the system-prompt persona and format, such as explanatory or concise, or write your own.

concepts.title: Git worktrees
concepts.summary: --worktree isolates each session in its own git worktree so parallel edits never collide.

concepts.title: Agent view
concepts.summary: One screen to dispatch and watch many sessions and see which ones need your input.

concepts.title: Agent teams
concepts.summary: Several full sessions coordinating through shared tasks and messages under a lead.

concepts.title: Session messaging
concepts.summary: Sessions can list and message each other on this machine, on other machines, or on the web.

concepts.title: Dynamic workflows
concepts.summary: A script Claude writes to orchestrate many subagents, rerunnable for audits, migrations, and research.

concepts.title: Headless (claude -p)
concepts.summary: Run non-interactively: pipe input in, get text or JSON out. The basis for scripts and CI.

concepts.title: /loop and /goal
concepts.summary: /loop repeats a prompt inside a session. /goal keeps Claude working until a condition holds.

concepts.title: Routines
concepts.summary: Automations on a schedule, API call, or GitHub event. Cloud routines run while your machine is off.

concepts.title: Channels
concepts.summary: Push webhooks, CI results, and chat messages into a running session through an MCP server.

concepts.title: GitHub, GitLab CI
concepts.summary: Respond to @claude in issues and PRs and run tasks in pipelines, including through cloud providers.

concepts.title: Code review
concepts.summary: Automated multi-agent PR review, /code-review, cloud ultrareview, and security plugins.

concepts.title: Artifacts
concepts.summary: Publish session output as live pages you can keep private, share with your org, or make public.

concepts.title: Settings scopes
concepts.summary: settings.json at user, project, local, and managed scopes. Managed settings win over everything else.

concepts.title: Permission rules
concepts.summary: Allow, ask, and deny rules per tool and argument pattern, for example Bash(npm test:*).

concepts.title: Sandboxing
concepts.summary: OS-level filesystem and network isolation for Bash, compared with dev containers, Docker, and VMs.

concepts.title: Security and data
concepts.summary: Built-in safeguards, prompt-injection defenses, data usage policy, and zero data retention.

concepts.title: Models and effort
concepts.summary: Choose the model, effort level, extended context, fast mode, and an advisor model for hard decisions.

concepts.title: Prompt caching
concepts.summary: Stable prompt prefixes are cached. Switching models or compacting causes a slower uncached turn.

concepts.title: Costs and usage
concepts.summary: /usage shows what drives your limits. Control spend with context hygiene, model choice, and team limits.

concepts.title: Debugging config
concepts.summary: /context, /doctor, /hooks, /mcp, and safe mode show what actually loaded and why.

concepts.title: Large codebases
concepts.summary: Monorepo patterns: nested CLAUDE.md files, sparse worktrees, code intelligence, and per-package skills.

concepts.title: Managed settings
concepts.summary: Push enforced settings, permission policy, and MCP allowlists to every machine or from the server.

concepts.title: Providers and auth
concepts.summary: Use Claude plans, Console API keys, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry.

concepts.title: LLM gateways
concepts.summary: Route traffic through Claude apps gateway or your own LLM gateway for SSO, model routing, and spend caps.

concepts.title: Network and proxies
concepts.summary: Proxies, custom certificate authorities, mTLS, corporate launchers, and dev containers.

concepts.title: Cloud environments
concepts.summary: Set network access and setup scripts for cloud sessions, or run them on your own runners.

concepts.title: Monitoring
concepts.summary: OpenTelemetry metrics and events plus an analytics dashboard for adoption and usage.

concepts.title: SDK basics
concepts.summary: Claude Code as a Python or TypeScript library, with the same agent loop and tools under your control.

concepts.title: Claude Code features
concepts.summary: Opt in to CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, and plugins from the filesystem inside SDK agents.

concepts.title: Custom tools and MCP
concepts.summary: Define in-process tools, connect MCP servers, use tool search, and declare subagents in code.

concepts.title: Sessions, streaming
concepts.summary: Resume and fork sessions, stream output, handle approvals, and return validated structured output.

concepts.title: Control, telemetry
concepts.summary: Permission callbacks, hooks as functions, checkpointing, cost tracking, and OpenTelemetry.

concepts.title: System prompts
concepts.summary: Use the claude_code preset, append to it, or replace it with a fully custom system prompt.

concepts.title: Hosting, security
concepts.summary: Run agents in containers with session persistence, tenant isolation, and credential controls.
